title: ADD CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS — invalid PostgreSQL syntax
expected_feedback: Standard: PostgreSQL does NOT support ADD CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS -- this is a syntax error. Use a DO block checking pg_constraint, and scope the lookup by conrelid: constraint names are unique per table, not per database, so an unqualified conname check silently skips the migration while reporting success. This is a common mistake from developers used to MySQL.
violated_rule: Constraint additions use idempotent DO blocks
